page.layout: One printed page, right side of the scan. Top centre: printed numeral "I." above an ornamental border. Then centred headings. Below them, one column of running text in roman and italic with Greek. No printed marginal notes. A strip of the neighbouring page shows at the far left and is excluded. Handwritten annotations in the right margin are excluded. Foot: signature "A" centred, catchword "omnis" at right.

main_text.head: SECTIO I. DE CORPORE NATVRALI IN GENERE.
PROOEMII
CAPVT I.
De definitione Physicæ.
main_text.p: Physicam scientiam contemplationibus aliquot illustraturi, recepto more Conatus nostros in proœmium & tractationem partimur.
main_text.head: Ἐξήγησις:
main_text.p: QVOD θεωρίμον[?] nos, id alij θεωδιδάγ-ματα[?], προλεγόμενα[?] aut praecognita appellant quæ sunt quasi praeludia quaedam totius artis vel scientiæ naturam in genere explicantia & repræsentantia, quibus animus discentis ad sequentia præparatur, & quid exspectare ab arte vel scientiâ possit, præcognoscit. Hinc illud Arist. 1. post analyt. πᾶσα διδασκαλία καὶ πᾶσα μάθησις διανοητικὴ ἐκ προϋπαρχούσης γίνεται γνώσεως[?]: h.e. Omnis disciplina, & omnis doctrina procedit ex præcognitione seu præmissâ cognitione: quod repetit 6. Eth. c. 4. ἐκ προγινωσκομένων πᾶσα διδασκαλία[?].

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations on the right ("Proœmium", "Synonymia", "Descriptio", "Usus") are not printed and are excluded. The Greek is copied from a small, uneven print. Doubtful letters are marked [?]. Printed "THESIS I." is treated as a numbered thesis and set as a paragraph. The large initial Q is joined to the word "Quod". The numeral "I." at the head is taken as the page number. The left strip of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "minius", "Maximus", "andus", "CTIO") is excluded.
